desc: Back to the launcher from the second screen's Start menu (TTYD_COMPANION_WINDOW, Settings, General): its row, its question in the second screen's window, A there: the tap goes to the game, which confirms it as the Start menu's A does at the point its own menu could open; the game goes back to its title and this program starts again on its launcher (as launcher_back_menu)
log_must: \[launcher-back\] confirmed on the second screen: sent to the game
